method: Human-authorized sixth verification round (Jaden, 2026-10-10: 'run a fresh independent verifier round for the behavior research stages'; re-sample after fixing mismatches). Before this round, every round-5 mismatch was fixed against the archived documents, and a population-wide sweep corrected missing table-header and row conditions, min/typ/max and DC/AC qualifiers, bound labels, document metadata and third-party-copy provenance labels, each edit checked against a verbatim quote on the cited archived page. New integer seed drawn once with secrets.randbits(63) before the sample was computed. One fresh-context reviewer agent per sampled entry, using the unchanged round-5 instructions, read only the entry gapfill, its generated record, FETCH_LEDGER.jsonl (URL-to-SHA256 mapping only) and the archived primary-source bytes, using PyMuPDF/pdftotext extraction and rendered pages; no web access, no other repository files, no prior verifier reports. Values, units, conditions, min/typ/max qualifiers, document metadata and provenance claims were re-derived; page-citation drift with the value present elsewhere in the same document is recorded as a note. Seventeen reviewer sessions hit an API usage limit mid-review and were resumed in their own unchanged context with no new information supplied; every result is the output of the reviewer that started that entry.
